reading_note: The arc moves from cosmology to anthropology by way of an organic image. First, the Grand Man — the Ancient celestial good perfected in His members — sends forth Divine Truth (the Protomē, the Youth-King) as the form of uprightness made manifest. Then a single sustained correspondence: pearls do not form in just any part of the sea, but in particular shells where a drop of rain from above mingles with sweet water below — so regenerate goods (pearls) are formed only where a discrete influx of celestial truth from above descends into a prepared natural mind (the oyster) holding the truths of the Word (sweet waters); divers (laborers in regeneration) bring these up from the abyss. The teaching then transposes this exactly onto the soul wearing the body: when the Mind of Light comes with Wisdom and Obedience, the soul is purified into a New Man without disturbance; when temptation/tarachē arises through stars above or bitter members below (in food, drink, desire, grief), the disturbance enters; but when the food (spiritual nourishment) is firm and select and the air of above is still, the living members within are conjoined with the living souls and the soul soars upward like a bird. The single arc: Divine influx from above + receptive natural below = the pearl of the regenerate man.
